name: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
summary: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on AI. Published in the Official Journal L series on 24 July 2026 and in force from the third day after publication, 27 July 2026. It defers high-risk application dates and adjusts several AI Act provisions.
key_obligations: High-risk AI systems under Annex III apply from 2 December 2027
High-risk AI systems under Annex I apply from 2 August 2028
Article 4 AI literacy changed to an obligation to take measures supporting AI literacy
Article 5 extended with prohibitions on systems generating non-consensual intimate images and child sexual abuse material, applying from 2 December 2026 (Article 113 as amended)
SMEs and small mid-cap enterprises (SMCs) may provide technical documentation in a simplified manner and get priority access to AI regulatory sandboxes
Special-category data processing for bias detection extended beyond high-risk providers under safeguards

timeline.note: Regulation dated 8 July 2026 (signature date per EUR-Lex title).
Entered into force on the third day following publication.
